creator: Alexander Terp
description: The Conversations submenu on an agent row or pane (which replaced the sidebar's Messages section, 2026-11-09) lists only that agent's one-to-one groups, because the core sends the shell a group's partner_pane and no other members. Multi-member groups are reachable from Window > Conversations only. Listing them per agent needs each group's member panes sent from the daemon through the core to the shell.
title: An agent's Conversations menu lists its multi-member groups too
